analyzed_vuln.description: Heap buffer overflow in Type_MLU_Write due to trusting mlu->UsedEntries when iterating mlu->Entries. The PoV causes a non-MLU object (read from cmsSigGamutTag as LUT16 data) to be treated as an MLU during profile save, so Type_MLU_Write reads past the 40-byte allocation at mlu->Entries[i].Len/StrW (crash at line 1591).
analyzed_vuln.conditions: In cms_profile_fuzzer, attacker-controlled ICC is opened, cmsReadTag(hProfile, cmsSigGamutTag) loads malformed tag data, then cmsSaveProfileToFile triggers SaveTags -> type handler WritePtr. For this PoV, tag/type confusion leaves TagPtrs entry with incompatible structure, and Type_MLU_Write uses its first fields as cmsMLU (especially UsedEntries) without validating object type/size, causing out-of-bounds read when UsedEntries exceeds actual allocated entries.
